causal_hypothesis: A forward B proposal can be descriptor-plausible and multi-view geometrically plausible yet map back to the wrong Pose-A carrier neighborhood. Same-view reciprocal descriptor cycle error is an independent observation-native identity discriminator and should reduce proposal regret without changing support or relational structure.

claim_boundary.fail: reciprocal-cycle as formulated is not promoted; any next frontend treatment requires a new preregistered surface.
claim_boundary.pass: reciprocal-cycle is promoted as an additional useful deterministic observation-native frontend primitive for the 2.5D mechanical surface; this does not establish learned generalization of a new network module.

controlled_change.cycle_rank: stable within-carrier/view rank of cycle_px ascending
controlled_change.cycle_raw: For frozen B proposal q_B: sample B descriptor at q_B; exact canonical coarse-to-fine descriptor search against same-view Pose-A foreground; q_hat_A is reverse match; cycle_px = ||q_hat_A - XY_A[v,i]||_2.
controlled_change.name: G only: add reciprocal cycle rank
controlled_change.reverse_descriptor_score: diagnostic provenance only; not a scoring factor

evaluation.failure_rule: If any primary pass-rule item fails, G2 is FAIL as formulated. No same-surface retune, weight sweep or threshold rescue.
evaluation.observable_disagreement_stratum: pretruth rows where G1 unary G_rank top proposal differs from reciprocal-cycle-rank top proposal
evaluation.pass_rule_origin: exact same four-criterion promotion standard used in frozen G1 prereg, with comparator renamed V5->G1; no G2 truth-informed threshold choice
evaluation.primary_comparator: G1 geometry-grounded G + unchanged V5 R
evaluation.primary_rows: all reliable truth-visible carrier/view rows whose already-frozen proposal row is nonempty

frozen.g1_geometry: exact raw reprojection and stable rank
frozen.proposal_support: exact forward top4 sites and scores
frozen.solver: exact pinned V5 solver semantics; 16 deterministic restarts; strict descent

phase_separation.phase0_preflight: hash source, checkpoint, all 16 family manifests, 8+8 raster bytes, and e01 sidecar opaque bytes. No sidecar deserialization.
phase_separation.phase1_observable: produce/freeze raster-only observable states; extract G2 evidence; solve G1 and G2; persist evidence and selections; truth_access=NONE throughout.
phase_separation.phase2_evaluator_only: reconstruct Problem-A authority from frozen rasters via _model_context, then use sidecar geometry only for evaluator mapping and oracle-best proposal scoring. Never alter proposal support or scores.
phase_separation.truth_open_gate: G2_PRETRUTH_FREEZE.json and every referenced observable/evidence/G1/G2 output must be persisted with SHA readback before evaluator sidecar semantics may open.

scientific_question: On a separately frozen confirmation16 surface, does adding observation-only same-view B-to-A reciprocal descriptor cycle rank to frozen G1 descriptor+geometry proposal evidence improve proposal identity selection while preserving exact G1 geometry, exact V5 R/support, matching cardinality and solver semantics?
